actions.createFolder.description: Creates a folder at given path.
actions.createFolder.props.folderPath.de: The new folder path e.g. `./myfolder`. For FTP/FTPS, it will create nested folders if necessary.
actions.createFolder.props.recursive.des: For SFTP only: Create parent directories if they do not exist
actions.create_file.description: Create a new file in the given path
actions.deleteFile.description: Deletes a file at given path.
actions.deleteFile.props.filePath.descri: The path of the file to delete e.g. `./myfolder/test.mp3`
actions.deleteFolder.description: Deletes an existing folder at given path.
actions.deleteFolder.props.folderPath.de: The path of the folder to delete e.g. `./myfolder`
actions.deleteFolder.props.recursive.des: Enable this option to delete the folder and all its contents, including subfolders and files.
actions.listFolderContents.description: Lists the contents of a given folder.
actions.listFolderContents.props.directo: The path of the folder to list e.g. `./myfolder`
actions.read_file_content.description: Read the content of a file.
actions.renameFileOrFolder.description: Renames a file or folder at given path.
actions.renameFileOrFolder.props.informa: Depending on the server you can also use this to move a file to another directory, as long as the directory exists.
actions.renameFileOrFolder.props.newPath: The new path of the file or folder e.g. `./myfolder/new-name.mp3`
actions.renameFileOrFolder.props.oldPath: The path of the file or folder to rename e.g. `./myfolder/test.mp3`
actions.upload_file.description: Upload a file to the given path.
actions.upload_file.props.fileName.descr: The path on the sftp server to store the file. e.g. `./myfolder/test.mp3`
auth.props.algorithm.description: The host key algorithm to use for SFTP connection. Only needed if you want to override the default algorithms (e.g., to support ssh-dss).
auth.props.allow_anonymous_login.descrip: Allow anonymous login to FTP servers (only applicable for FTP/FTPS)
auth.props.allow_unauthorized_certificat: Allow connections to servers with self-signed certificates
auth.props.password.description: The password to authenticate with. Either this or private key is required. When using a private key, this field is used as the passphrase to decrypt the key.
auth.props.privateKey.description: The private key to authenticate with. Either this or password is required.
description: Connect to FTP, FTPS or SFTP servers
triggers.new_file.description: Trigger when a new file is created or modified.
triggers.new_file.props.path.description: The path to watch for new files
